title: A two-phase ultrafine-grained NbMoTaWV refractory high entropy alloy with prominent compressive properties
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying of elemental powders (Nb, Mo, Ta, W, V) for 40 h, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1500 °C for 10 min under 30 MPa pressure and vacuum pressure <8 Pa.
